pathways.subject: SECQ
pathways.title: Cybersecurity Fundamentals
objectives: Security principles and the CIA triad
Threats, vulnerabilities, malware and social engineering
Identity, authentication and access control
Network security, firewalls and segmentation
Risk management, governance and compliance
Incident response, logging and recovery

pathways.subject: DAQ
pathways.title: Data Analytics Foundations
objectives: Data literacy, data types and quality
Excel formulas, tables and pivot tables
SQL filtering, grouping, joins and aggregation
Power Query and data preparation
Power BI modelling, DAX and visualisation
Governance, privacy and report security

pathways.subject: AIQ

objectives: AI, machine learning and generative AI fundamentals
Prompt design and iterative refinement
Hallucinations, bias and output verification
Responsible AI, privacy and intellectual property
Workflow automation and human review
Workplace use cases and productivity measurement

pathways.subject: CONQ

objectives: Site roles, responsibilities and communication
Risk assessments and method statements
Working at height, lifting and temporary works awareness
PPE, welfare, housekeeping and incident reporting
Scheduling, quality and subcontractor coordination
Environmental controls, permits and site records

objectives: Double-entry bookkeeping and ledgers
Invoices, credit notes and VAT basics
Bank reconciliation and trial balances
Gross pay, deductions and net pay
PAYE, National Insurance and pensions
